fastq_dir.title: FASTQ Folders
fastq_dir.description: Datasets or folders holding the FASTQ files (.fastq.gz). Cell Ranger finds the files of each library in the samplesheet by its sample name

transcriptome_dir.title: Transcriptome
transcriptome_dir.description: Reference genome used for alignment of RNAseq data

vdj_dir.title: V(D)J Reference
vdj_dir.description: Reference genome used for alignment of V(D)J data

include_introns.title: Include Introns
include_introns.description: Include reads which align to intronic regions

hashtag_csv.title: Hashtagging Reference
hashtag_csv.description: Reference file defining the sequences used for hashtag multiplexing

feature_csv.title: Feature Barcode Reference
feature_csv.description: Reference file defining the sequences used for feature barcoding

emptydrops_minimum_umis.title: (optional) Minimum UMIs for Cell Calling
emptydrops_minimum_umis.description: Barcodes with fewer UMIs are not considered in the second (EmptyDrops) step of cell calling. Leave blank for the CellRanger default of 500; 10X suggests starting at 100 to recover more cells. Requires CellRanger 7.1 or later

global_minimum_umis.title: (optional) Minimum UMIs per Cell
global_minimum_umis.description: Barcodes with fewer UMIs are not called as cells. Leave blank to keep every called cell (the CellRanger default). Requires CellRanger 8.0 or later

schema.title: Samplesheet
schema.description: One row per library: the sample name its FASTQ files start with (the part before _S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz) and its feature type. A Gene Expression and a Multiplexing Capture library are required; any other library is analyzed for each sample after demultiplexing.

sample.title: Sample
sample.errorMessage: Sample names can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores

schema.title: Sample Hashtags
schema.description: One row per sample, with the hashtag used to label its cells. Hashtag IDs are the ids in the Hashtagging Reference; separate several with a pipe (e.g. Hashtag1|Hashtag2).

sample_id.title: Sample
sample_id.errorMessage: Sample names can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores

cmo_ids.title: Hashtag IDs
cmo_ids.errorMessage: Hashtag IDs cannot contain spaces or commas; separate several with a pipe (e.g. Hashtag1|Hashtag2)
